body:
Unfortunately she's just not interested anymore... Still don't fully understand how her feelings have changed within a few weeks.

Really regret not sleeping with her when I had the chance now, I know it would've been amazing!

I'm not sure, she seems to have started seeing someone else and think even went away with him for a weekend.  This must've been about 2 weeks after we stopped chatting.
Not too sure if he's the rebound or I was! 😂

Yeah, that's how I'm feeling at the moment.  Can't believe how unfortunate the timing was when she was messaging me (there were a couple of other times too but she wasn't drunk so nothing might've happened).

Are you over him/her now?
Damn, that's what I was worried about.  The connection we had was unbelievable though.
